summary: The change introduces an undeclared dependency on jsonwebtoken, unvalidated JWT_SECRET environment variable usage, and commits a transient runtime state file.

findings.title: Undeclared dependency `jsonwebtoken`
findings.body: src/token.js requires `jsonwebtoken`, but this package is not declared under `dependencies` in package.json. This will cause a `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` crash in fresh environments and CI/CD pipelines.
findings.recommendation: Add `jsonwebtoken` to `dependencies` in package.json (e.g., via `npm install jsonwebtoken`).

findings.title: Unvalidated `JWT_SECRET` environment variable
findings.body: `issue()` passes `process.env.JWT_SECRET` directly to `jwt.sign()` without verifying that it is defined. If the environment variable is missing, `jwt.sign()` will throw an uncaught exception (`"secretOrPrivateKey" must have a value`), failing token issuance at runtime.
findings.recommendation: Validate that `process.env.JWT_SECRET` is defined before signing, throwing a clear configuration error if it is missing.

findings.title: Stray runtime state file committed
findings.body: `.omc/state/job.json` contains transient execution metadata (PID and job status) that should not be tracked in version control.
findings.recommendation: Remove `.omc/state/job.json` from git and add `.omc/` to `.gitignore`.

samples.summary: The changes introduce an undeclared dependency, unvalidated secret access during token signing, and a stray runtime state file.

findings.title: Undeclared dependency 'jsonwebtoken'
findings.body: src/token.js requires 'jsonwebtoken', but the package is not listed under dependencies in package.json. In fresh environments or production deployments, importing or executing this module will throw MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
findings.recommendation: Add 'jsonwebtoken' to package.json dependencies via 'npm install jsonwebtoken'.

findings.title: Missing validation for JWT_SECRET environment variable
findings.body: issue() passes process.env.JWT_SECRET directly to jwt.sign without verifying it is defined. If the environment variable is missing, jsonwebtoken throws a runtime error ('secretOrPrivateKey must have a value').
findings.recommendation: Validate that process.env.JWT_SECRET is non-empty before signing, throwing a clear configuration error if unset.

findings.title: Stray runtime state file tracked in working tree
findings.body: The file .omc/state/job.json contains ephemeral process state (jobId and pid) and was added to the working tree instead of being excluded from version control.
findings.recommendation: Remove .omc/state/job.json from git tracking and add .omc/ to .gitignore.

findings.recommendation: Remove .omc/state/job.json from git and add .omc/ to .gitignore.
